claim: sep demo runs bundled sample data in an isolated temporary workspace.
sandbox: fresh process; assert temporary source and artifact exist, one path is traced, and the value is redacted

claim: The CLI makes no network calls.
sandbox: run sep demo with an injected socket interceptor; fail if the process opens a network socket
